video.title: I Built a Roblox World With My Daughter Using AI | Wild Racing + AI Update
video.description:
A lunchtime AI update from Toby Glenn: how my daughter’s Wild Rebellion drawings grew into an animated world and a Roblox project, why Wild Racing became the focus, and which AI apps I’m actually using.

I discuss my hands-on experiences with Muse, ChatGPT Dot, Gemini, Antigravity, Sol, Astra and other models—including app overlap, subscription usage and shopping-agent frustrations. There’s also a fitness-tech detour into wearable subscriptions and the devices we’re testing.

This is the original livestream replay, including the opening setup and a brief multistream troubleshooting segment. Model capabilities, offers, prices and platform policies reflect the discussion on October 21, 2026; opinions are based on my experience.
